description: Dear Friends and Neighbors, Today, we remember and mourn all those that lost their lives while serving in the military and honor the sacrifices they made for our country and our freedom. As Ronald Reagan so eloquently stated, we should never forget that “Freedom is never more than one generation away from extinction. We did not pass it to our children in the bloodstream.
